name: Cresta
tagline: Unifies an autonomous AI Agent, real-time human Agent Assist and Conversation Intelligence on one contact-center platform, enterprise, custom-quoted, no self-serve tier.
verdict: Cresta's real differentiator among this category's four existing enterprise support-agent listings is scope: instead of selling an AI Agent that replaces a human conversation, it unifies an AI Agent, real-time Agent Assist for the humans still in the loop, and Conversation Intelligence analytics on one shared record, a genuine "augment, don't just replace" position, backed by real scale ($280M+ raised, 500+ employees, named case studies like Xanterra's $3.3M revenue lift). The honest catch: pricing is almost entirely opaque, the only public number anywhere is an AWS Marketplace listing for the narrower Agent Assist product alone, starting at $150,000/year for one channel, while the full AI Agent/Conversation Intelligence suite is custom-quoted with no self-serve tier or free trial. Pick Cresta if a blended AI-plus-human operation is the actual goal and you can run an enterprise sales cycle; skip it if you want transparent self-serve pricing or a fast trial, which none of this category's enterprise players (Cresta, Sierra, Decagon) currently offer.
